newsitem.title: USA: Vitesse sets three-for-two stock split.
newsitem.headline: Vitesse sets three-for-two stock split.

text.p: CAMARILLO, Calif., Jan 29 (REuter) - Vitesse Semiconductor said Wednesday its board of directors has approved a resolution authorizing a three-for-two stock split of its common stock.

The split will be a stock dividend of one share of common stock for each two shares of common stock outstanding on February 12. The record date for the stock split, and the company's stock price will be adjusted on the following trading day, February 13.
Vitesse has about 23.1 million shares of common stock outstanding. Fractional shares will be piad in cash, the company said.
